description: The 22-page Backup Service REST reference splits cleanly into two undeclared documentation templates for stating required permissions. GET/list/info-shaped endpoints (backup-get-cluster-info, backup-get-expired-backups, backup-get-plan-info, backup-get-repository-info, backup-get-task-info, backup-manage-config, backup-node-threads) get a dedicated 'Required Permissions' section naming a disjunction of three roles (Full Admin / Backup Full Admin / Read-Only Admin). Write-shaped endpoints (archive, create, delete-backup, delete-plan, delete-repository, pause-and-resume, trigger-backup, trigger-merge, trigger-prune) state only a single Full-Admin-only sentence buried in the curl-syntax prose, no dedicated section, no broader role disjunction. backup-examine-data.md breaks the pattern in the wrong direction: it is a read-only operation (its own description says it only 'retrieves' data) but follows the STRICTER write-shaped pattern (Full Admin only, no dedicated section) rather than the broader read-shaped one. A reader cannot infer which permission tier an endpoint needs from its HTTP verb or its read/write semantics alone.
